factual_claims.claim: AAC Clyde Space’s 2025 performance weakened financially compared with 2024, primarily because of programme delays, although the company continued to expand its recurring data and services business.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'Two programme-related delays materially affected revenue, cash flow and order intake in 2025... Data & Services continued to grow, increasing by 80 percent.' CEO Review confirms expansion of Data & Services and recurring revenues.

factual_claims.claim: Group net sales decreased 16% to SEK 295.3 million from SEK 352.9 million, while total revenue declined to SEK 337.8 million from SEK 408.8 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income: Net sales 2025: 295,283 kSEK ($295.3M$), 2024: 352,857 kSEK ($352.9M$); Total revenue 2025: 337,758 kSEK ($337.8M$), 2024: 408,750 kSEK ($408.8M$). Percentage decrease aligns with 16%.

factual_claims.claim: EBITDA fell to SEK 17.5 million from SEK 46.7 million, although the company reported a positive EBITDA for the third consecutive year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income: EBITDA 2025: 17,463 kSEK ($17.5M$), 2024: 46,694 kSEK ($46.7M$). CEO Review states 'three consecutive years of positive EBITDA'.

factual_claims.claim: EBIT deteriorated to a loss of SEK 40.0 million from a loss of SEK 4.0 million, and the loss after tax increased to SEK 46.6 million from SEK 5.7 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income: EBIT 2025: -39,985 kSEK ($-40.0M$), 2024: -4,022 kSEK ($-4.0M$); Loss after tax 2025: -46,556 kSEK ($-46.6M$), 2024: -5,746 kSEK ($-5.7M$).

factual_claims.claim: Earnings per share declined to SEK -7.63 from SEK -1.00.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income: Earnings per share attributable to Parent Company shareholders 2025: -7.63 SEK, 2024: -1.00 SEK (Note 31).

factual_claims.claim: The decline was concentrated in Products & Missions, where sales fell to SEK 245.0 million from SEK 346.0 million and EBITDA to SEK 16.8 million from SEK 51.6 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 6 Segment Information: Products & Missions net sales 2025: 245,000 kSEK ($245.0M$), 2024: 345,998 kSEK ($346.0M$); EBITDA 2025: 16,791 kSEK ($16.8M$), 2024: 51,579 kSEK ($51.6M$).

factual_claims.claim: Data & Services continued to develop strongly: sales increased 80% to SEK 80.1 million from SEK 44.9 million, and EBITDA rose to SEK 27.8 million from SEK 21.1 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 6 Segment Information: Data & Services net sales 2025: 80,142 kSEK ($80.1M$), 2024: 44,887 kSEK ($44.9M$); EBITDA 2025: 27,801 kSEK ($27.8M$), 2024: 21,121 kSEK ($21.1M$). Growth of 80% is calculated as (80,142-44,887)/44,887 ≈ 78.7%, rounded to 80%.

factual_claims.claim: The company attributed the weaker overall outcome to delays in two programmes.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'Two programme-related delays materially affected revenue, cash flow and order intake in 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: Technical discussions involving an end customer and subcontractor postponed approximately SEK 32 million of milestone revenue into 2026, while political and procurement developments delayed the start of the EPS-Sterna programme.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'In one programme, technical discussions between an end customer and a subcontractor delayed milestone recognition, shifting approximately SEK 32 M into 2026. In the EPS-Sterna programme, political and procurement developments postponed project initiation.'

factual_claims.claim: Sedna satellite commissioning also took longer than planned, and VIREON’s initial launch was delayed by the launch provider.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'Commissioning of the two Sedna satellites took longer than planned... Launch of the first two VIREON™ satellites was delayed through rescheduling by the launch provider.'

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow consequently changed from an inflow of SEK 56.8 million in 2024 to an outflow of SEK 72.6 million in 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows: Cash flow from operating activities 2025: -72,600 kSEK ($-72.6M$), 2024: 56,789 kSEK ($56.8M$).

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents decreased to SEK 30.1 million from SEK 49.7 million, but the Group had an undrawn overdraft facility of SEK 50 million, giving total available cash and facilities of SEK 80.1 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Balance Sheet: Cash and cash equivalents 2025: 30,117 kSEK ($30.1M$), 2024: 49,676 kSEK ($49.7M$). factual_claims.claim: The equity ratio strengthened to 80% from 71%, supported by two directed share issues that raised approximately SEK 64.5 million in June and SEK 50.3 million in December before transaction costs.

factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'The Board of Directors proposes that no dividend will be paid and that the retained earnings of SEK 628,192,029 be carried forward.'

factual_claims.claim: Operationally, the Group reorganised into Products & Missions and Data & Services, brought Sedna-1 and Sedna-2 into operation, delivered its first CubeCAT laser terminals and began assembling the VIREON Earth Observation constellation.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'In April 2025, AAC Clyde Space restructured its operations into two business segments: Products & Missions and Data & Services... AAC Clyde Space begun assembly of the first two satellites in its VIREON™ Earth Observation constellation.'

factual_claims.claim: INFLECION Phase 1 was also contracted with ESA.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: 2025 in brief: 'INFLECION Phase 1 contract signed with ESA for INFLECION, a programme to develop a satellite constellation for maritime intelligence... In April 2025, AAC Clyde Space announced a EUR 0.85 M contract with ESA for the INFLECION project.'

factual_claims.claim: After year-end, AAC received an EUR 76.3 million order from OHB Sweden for 20 EPS-Sterna radiometers; by the end of March 2026, the company reported an order backlog of approximately SEK 1.1 billion.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Significant events after the end of the year: 'AAC Clyde Space has received an order from OHB Sweden valued at EUR 76.3 M (approx. factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
